events.title: Where the Veil Thins: Act 1 Demo 2026-10-19 hotfix (Steam Next Fest, v0.9.0)
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who reported the crash on the way to the Academy. On the Steam Deck the game ran out of memory as the Academy loaded, just after the First Summoning; it now loads with far less memory, and every platform loads much faster (the Academy now takes a few seconds instead of half a minute).
